content: {"reasoning": "The denial is PR-204 (service not covered under the patient's plan), and eligibility has lapsed. Prior auth is not required, so this isn't an auth problem, and retro-auth/P2P aren't offered. A PR-204 for non-covered/lapsed eligibility is not curable by records, corrections, or a medical-necessity appeal since the coverage itself doesn't apply. With assignment of benefits on file but no coverage, the balance shifts to patient responsibility (PR prefix indicates patient responsibility).", "action": "bill_patient"}
